title: National Lifeguard Pool
description:
The NL Pool certification is designed to develop the fundamental values, judgment, knowledge, skills and fitness required by lifeguards. This course emphasizes the lifeguarding skills, principles and practices, and the decision-making processes that assist the lifeguard in providing effective safety supervision in swimming pool environments. Prerequisite: Bronze Cross (does not need to be current) and Standard First Aid or Aquatic Emergency Care (current award recommended) by the first day of the NL course. Emergency First Aid certificates obtained in high school are not accepted. Alert Manual ($41.00) is required and not included in fee. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $65.00.Students must be prepared to bring bathing suit, manual and paper for each class. Prerequisite: Bronze Cross (does not need to be current), Standard First Aid or Aquatic Emergency Care (current award recommended) and you must be 15 years old by the last day of the course. Candidates will need to provide proof of the prerequisites on the 1st day of the course to the instructor or be sent home with no refund. Emergency First Aid certificates obtained in high school are not accepted. Recognized Agencies for Standard First Aid or Aquatic Emergency Care are: any Canadian branch of the Lifesaving Society, Canadian Red Cross, St John Ambulance, Canadian Heart and Stroke Foundation or Canadian Ski Patrol.
100% attendance is required.

title: Reserve in Advance: Beginner Pickleball Adult
description:
This program is specifically for beginners (new and learning players) to continue to build on their skills in a fun and inclusive space. In this program everyone plays with all the other beginners as they rotate on and off thru their games.
Reserve in advance is available for this activity, check-in prior to activity start time to avoid losing your reservation. Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. No waitlist.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

description:
In this level you will learn how to: safely fall down, stand up, walk on the ice forwards and backwards, two foot glides, one foot glides, glide turn, and stops. This class is suitable for beginners and those who are comfortable on the ice but have never had formal lessons.

A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. Helmets are available to borrow no charge. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register in more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Skating Lessons: Youth 1
description: Designed for beginner youth skaters: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. This class is a great way to meet new people, get some exercise and develop basic skills at your own pace. In this level you will learn how to safely fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register in more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Skating Lessons: Youth 2
description:

Pre-requisite: Youth I or an evaluation. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. Helmets are available to borrow no charge. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register in more than one lesson set at a time.
ageText: Age at least 11 yrs but less than 18 yrs,

title: Intro to Gliders
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Gliders skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. If you have basic skating experience please attend an evaluation session. In this level, children receive a facility tour, learn about safety on ice, how to fall down and stand up, and walk on ice without assistance, along with other building blocks to progress to the next level. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Skating Lessons: Parent & Tot Adult Participation
description: Join us for our skate lesson program designed to make your child's experience on ice a positive one. Our instructor will work with you and your child to develop their basic skating skills using games and activities. Maximum of 1 child per adult. A CSA approved hockey or snow sport helmet is mandatory for both adult and child in this program. All children must be accompanied on the ice by an adult on skates or ice cleats. Skate and helmet rental are included in the program price. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Power Skating
description: Designed for those who want to improve their speed, agility, power and control while getting a great workout! This course includes explosive acceleration, speed, skating efficiency, lengthening your stride, high velocity turns and pivots, driving to the net, explosive starts and dexterity all led by a qualified instructor. A CSA-approved hockey helmet and full hockey equipment are mandatory for all participants. Please bring your own stick. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons.

title: Reserve In Advance: Yoga Hatha / Core
description:
Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This classical form of yoga is a rejuvenating practice that releases tension from the muscles accumulated in everyday life and sports activities. Learn to breathe deeply while experiencing a variety of postures to stimulate the body physically and mentally. Through this practice you enhance flexibility, increase muscle tone and concentration, detoxify the organs and feel a state of deep relaxation. A variation of poses will be offered with an emphasis on the core muscles.

title: Intro to Gliders
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Gliders skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. If you have basic skating experience please attend an evaluation session. In this level, children receive a facility tour, learn about safety on ice, how to fall down and stand up, and walk on ice without assistance, along with other building blocks to progress to the next level. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Blades 1
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Blades skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. In this level, children learn about safety on the ice, how to fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. By the end of this level children need to be able to skate the width of the rink with confidence using both feet along with demonstrating other building blocks. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Blades 1
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Blades skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. In this level, children learn about safety on the ice, how to fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. By the end of this level children need to be able to skate the width of the rink with confidence using both feet along with demonstrating other building blocks. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

description:

Help your child strengthen their skills and passion for golf — sign up today!

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description:
Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 6. Swimmers continue developing front crawl, back crawl and breaststroke. Swimmers develop individual fitness to meet a timed 100m swim and 350m workout. Water proficiency skills include swimming with clothes, ready position, and feet-first/head-first surface dives. Demonstrating the ability to conduct a primary assessment and calling EMS are included as first aid skills. Victim recognition and throwing assists are other key elements of the program. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description:
Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 7 – Rookie Patrol. Ranger Patrol enhances capability in the water including stride entries and underwater, forward and backward somersaults. Swimmers learn lifesaving sport skills with a lifesaving stroke medley, timed object support and a non-contact rescue with a buoyant aid. Eggbeater kick and increased fitness levels are developed to meet a 200m timed swim. First aid focuses on unconscious victims and obstructed airway procedures. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

description:

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description:
Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 6. Swimmers continue developing front crawl, back crawl and breaststroke. Swimmers develop individual fitness to meet a timed 100m swim and 350m workout. Water proficiency skills include swimming with clothes, ready position, and feet-first/head-first surface dives. Demonstrating the ability to conduct a primary assessment and calling EMS are included as first aid skills. Victim recognition and throwing assists are other key elements of the program. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description:
Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 7 – Rookie Patrol. Ranger Patrol enhances capability in the water including stride entries and underwater, forward and backward somersaults. Swimmers learn lifesaving sport skills with a lifesaving stroke medley, timed object support and a non-contact rescue with a buoyant aid. Eggbeater kick and increased fitness levels are developed to meet a 200m timed swim. First aid focuses on unconscious victims and obstructed airway procedures. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: National Lifeguard Pool
description:
The NL Pool certification is designed to develop the fundamental values, judgment, knowledge, skills and fitness required by lifeguards. This course emphasizes the lifeguarding skills, principles and practices, and the decision-making processes that assist the lifeguard in providing effective safety supervision in swimming pool environments. Prerequisite: Bronze Cross (does not need to be current) and Standard First Aid or Aquatic Emergency Care (current award recommended) by the first day of the NL course. Emergency First Aid certificates obtained in high school are not accepted. Must be 15 years old by the last day of the course. Alert Manual is required and not included in fee. There is a non-refundable exam fee.
Students must be prepared to bring bathing suit, manual and paper for each class. Candidates will need to provide proof of the prerequisites on the 1st day of the course to the instructor or be sent home with no refund. Emergency First Aid certificates obtained in high school are not accepted. Recognized Agencies for Standard First Aid or Aquatic Emergency Care are: any Canadian branch of the Lifesaving Society, Canadian Red Cross, St John Ambulance, Canadian Heart and Stroke Foundation or Canadian Ski Patrol. 100% attendance is required.

title: Bronze Medallion
description: Prerequisites: Must be 13 years old OR have Bronze Star. Understand the lifesaving principles embodied in the four components of water rescue education: judgment, knowledge, skill and fitness. Rescuers learn self rescue techniques, defence and release methods, and tows and carries in preparation for challenging rescues involving conscious and unconscious victims of various types, including spinal injuries and circulatory emergencies. Lifesavers develop stroke efficiency and endurance in a timed swim. Includes the CPR-A certification. Canadian Life Saving Manual is required. There is a non-refundable exam fee. 100% attendance is recommended.

title: Bronze Cross
description: Prerequisite: Bronze Medallion. Designed for lifesavers who want the challenge of more advanced training, including an introduction to safety supervision in aquatic facilities. Swimmers develop proficiency at performing patient assessments, managing aquatic spinal injuries and preventing loss of life in a variety of aquatic emergencies, while developing stroke endurance and fitness training skills. Includes the CPR-C certification and is one of the prerequisite awards for all advanced Lifeguarding and Leadership training programs. It is also worth two Grade 11 high school credits. Canadian Life Saving Manual is required. There is a non-refundable exam fee. 100% attendance is recommended.

title: Swim & Lifesaving Instructor
description: The Swim & Lifesaving Instructor is a combination course designed for those who wish to teach the Lifesaving Society's learn-to-swim and lifesaving programs. Candidates are trained using a competency-based model that walks them through teaching and evaluation philosophy and the techniques/approaches required to teach developing swimmers, water rescue, first aid and related aquatic skills. Instructors also learn about long-term and short-term planning, class management, safety supervision, and the principles of evaluation. This course includes a supervised practice teaching component that will better prepare candidates for future job opportunities as an instructor. The Swim and Lifesaving Instructor Kit is not included in the course fee and must be purchased at the front desk prior to the program start date.Prerequisite: Must be 15 years old by last day of the course and hold a Bronze Cross certificate (need not be current). Must have completed Adapted Swim Instructor Course - Online Session: Meeting the Needs of Diverse Swimmers found on the Lifesaving Society BC & Yukon branch website.

title: Swim & Lifesaving Instructor
description: The Swim & Lifesaving Instructor is a combination course designed for those who wish to teach the Lifesaving Society's learn-to-swim and lifesaving programs. Candidates are trained using a competency-based model that walks them through teaching and evaluation philosophy and the techniques/approaches required to teach developing swimmers, water rescue, first aid and related aquatic skills. Instructors also learn about long-term and short-term planning, class management, safety supervision, and the principles of evaluation. This course includes a supervised practice teaching component that will better prepare candidates for future job opportunities as an instructor. The Swim and Lifesaving Instructor Kit is not included in the course fee and must be purchased at the front desk prior to the program start date.Prerequisite: Must be 15 years old by last day of the course and hold a Bronze Cross certificate (need not be current). Must have completed Adapted Swim Instructor Course - Online Session: Meeting the Needs of Diverse Swimmers found on the Lifesaving Society BC & Yukon branch website.

title: Making Comics
description:
Do you want to learn to tell stories through panels, word balloons, action and dialogue? Welcome to the exciting world of comics, where writing and drawing come together to tell incredible stories! Whether you are inspired by the action of shonen manga, the real-life drama of autobiographical graphic novels, or the jokes and gags of comic strips, there is something for you in this class! Learn the techniques, tools and practices of comics arts, all while developing your own story over the course of this five-week comics adventure. No previous drawing or writing experience is required!
Instructor: Stephanie Broder

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Racquetball ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. For all ages programs, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (6-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court- Squash
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for Squash.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants arriving 10 minutes or more late may lose their spot.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Lifesaving Instructor - Short Course
description: Lifesaving Instructor & Examiner (Short Course) prepares Lifesaving Society Swim Instructors to teach and evaluate the Society's Lifesaving programs. Candidates are trained using a competency-based model that walks through them teaching and evaluation philosophy and the techniques/approaches required to teach lifesaving skills. Instructors refine their long-term and short-term planning, class management, safety supervision, and the principles of evaluation. The Lifesaving Instructor Kit ($130) is not included in the course fee and must be purchased at the front desk prior to the program start date.Pre-requisite: Swim Instructor (must have taken the LSS version of the SI full course, Red Cross transfers do not count).

title: Blades 1
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Blades skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. In this level, children learn about safety on the ice, how to fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. By the end of this level children need to be able to skate the width of the rink with confidence using both feet along with demonstrating other building blocks. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Reserve In Advance: Pickleball All Ages
description:
Please arrive early and check in at the gymnasium to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Parent & Tot 2 Goldfish: Adult Participation
description: Prerequisite: age 12-24 months. Parent & Tot 2 teaches toddlers how to play in the water safely! They’ll learn how to enter and exit the water with help from their parent/caregiver and will play games to encourage them to get their face wet and blow bubbles in the water. Toddlers will also develop floating and kicking skills with the support of their parent/caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 1 yr but less than 2 yrs,

title: Parent & Tot 1 Jellyfish: Adult Participation
description: Prerequisite: age 4-12 months. Parent & Tot 1 provides an orientation to water for infants and their parent/caregiver. Parents/caregivers will learn how to swim safely with their infant in the pool through instruction of holds and supports. Infants will be introduced to getting their face wet, blowing bubbles and floating with the help of their caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

description:

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description:
Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 6. Swimmers continue developing front crawl, back crawl and breaststroke. Swimmers develop individual fitness to meet a timed 100m swim and 350m workout. Water proficiency skills include swimming with clothes, ready position, and feet-first/head-first surface dives. Demonstrating the ability to conduct a primary assessment and calling EMS are included as first aid skills. Victim recognition and throwing assists are other key elements of the program. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description:
Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 7 – Rookie Patrol. Ranger Patrol enhances capability in the water including stride entries and underwater, forward and backward somersaults. Swimmers learn lifesaving sport skills with a lifesaving stroke medley, timed object support and a non-contact rescue with a buoyant aid. Eggbeater kick and increased fitness levels are developed to meet a 200m timed swim. First aid focuses on unconscious victims and obstructed airway procedures. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description:
Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 6. Swimmers continue developing front crawl, back crawl and breaststroke. Swimmers develop individual fitness to meet a timed 100m swim and 350m workout. Water proficiency skills include swimming with clothes, ready position, and feet-first/head-first surface dives. Demonstrating the ability to conduct a primary assessment and calling EMS are included as first aid skills. Victim recognition and throwing assists are other key elements of the program. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description:
Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 7 – Rookie Patrol. Ranger Patrol enhances capability in the water including stride entries and underwater, forward and backward somersaults. Swimmers learn lifesaving sport skills with a lifesaving stroke medley, timed object support and a non-contact rescue with a buoyant aid. Eggbeater kick and increased fitness levels are developed to meet a 200m timed swim. First aid focuses on unconscious victims and obstructed airway procedures. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description:
Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 6. Swimmers continue developing front crawl, back crawl and breaststroke. Swimmers develop individual fitness to meet a timed 100m swim and 350m workout. Water proficiency skills include swimming with clothes, ready position, and feet-first/head-first surface dives. Demonstrating the ability to conduct a primary assessment and calling EMS are included as first aid skills. Victim recognition and throwing assists are other key elements of the program. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description:
Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 7 – Rookie Patrol. Ranger Patrol enhances capability in the water including stride entries and underwater, forward and backward somersaults. Swimmers learn lifesaving sport skills with a lifesaving stroke medley, timed object support and a non-contact rescue with a buoyant aid. Eggbeater kick and increased fitness levels are developed to meet a 200m timed swim. First aid focuses on unconscious victims and obstructed airway procedures. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

title: Ceramics 1: Handbuilding
description:
This is a satellite program operated by the ceramics staff at the Shadbolt Centre for the Arts, City of Burnaby's internationally renown ceramic arts facility. Try pottery in a purpose-built clay studio! You will learn several foundational handbuilding methods such as slabs, coils and pinching to create functional and sculptural works. You will also learn surface decoration techniques using underglaze. Clay and supplies included in course fee. No class October 12. Instructor: Allysha Hurd
Please note that participants will be eligible to register for Ceramics: Open Workshop for Current Students on Tuesdays from 1-3pm to practice their skills outside of regular class time. The instructor will share Open Workshop registration details during the first class.

title: Flute or Piano: Private Lesson Long-Term Georgia Tuhten
description:
Students can sign up for private flute, beginning piano or theory lessons from fall through spring. Instructor: Georgia Tuhten.
- Prorated Fees: Class fees will be adjusted based on the date of enrollment, beginning with the first scheduled class attended.- Private & Semi-Private Options: Select private lessons may be converted into semi-private sessions for two students upon request, please contact the Music and Media Arts Programmer for details. - Make-Up Lessons & Credits: Make-up classes or account credits are only issued in the event of instructor absence or an unexpected facility closure. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer make-up sessions or credits for student absences.
To give long-term arts students ample time to determine if a long-term program is right for them, students can attend 4 classes before a yearlong commitment is required. If you withdraw during this period, you will be charged only for each class you attend without being charged the City of Burnaby refund fee of 10%. Withdrawals/refunds are not permitted after the start of the 5th class of a long-term program. Payment plan option (via credit card payments) available: 50% of payment due at time of registration, 25% due on Dec 15, and 25% due on Mar 15.

title: Reserve In Advance: Stretch Fusion
description:
Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This is an ideal class for anyone wishing to add more stretching to their workouts. Whether you are a fitness enthusiast, weight trainer, basketball player or swimmer, there is never enough time dedicated to stretching. Supple, flexible bodies help prevent muscle aches, strains and injuries. Stretch muscles from head to toe in this hour long class.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Jr Golf | FUNdamentals (age 5-7) | Skill Development
description:
Level 2: Building Skills & Confidence — Advancing Your Child’s Golf Game
This 4-week program is designed for young golfers ready to build on the basics and take their skills to the next level. Through engaging practice sessions, kids will refine their putting, chipping, and full swings while learning key aspects of golf rules and etiquette. It’s a great way to boost confidence, improve technique, and deepen their understanding of the game — all in a fun and supportive setting.
Program Details:
  • Duration: 4 sessions (45 minutes each)
  • Equipment: Golf clubs provided if needed, so there’s no need to purchase equipment
  • Weather: Sessions run rain or shine, with access to a covered, heated practice range

Cancellation Policy:
  • Cancellations require a 7-day notice for a full refund

This program is ideal for kids who have some golf experience or have completed the beginner level and are excited to keep progressing. Our friendly coaches help each child develop their skills at their own pace, fostering a positive learning environment that encourages growth and a lifelong love for golf.
Help your child strengthen their skills and passion for golf — sign up today!

description: Join us for an opportunity to sample various gym sports such as basketball, soccer, floor hockey and more. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program.

title: After School: Lego and Games
description: Children are given the space to play, create, learn and use their imaginations while playing with various games and using LEGO®. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program.
ageText: Age at least 5 yrs but less than 9 yrs,

title: After School: Science Discoveries
description: Participants will have lots of opportunity to explore different aspects of science in this hands-on class. They will try different experiments and discuss how science is an important part of our everyday world. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program.
ageText: Age at least 7 yrs but less than 11 yrs,

title: After School: Nature Adventures
description: Join us in the outdoor program where we will explore nature and all it has to offer. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program. No program October 23.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 10 yrs,

title: After School: Adventures in Leadership
description: What makes a good leader? The Adventures in Leadership program will help kids learn leadership skills that build confidence and increase self-esteem through team building activities and learning the debrief process. Everyone will be given the opportunity to plan and run an activity of their choice. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program. No program November 20.

title: Adult Golf | The Starter Hut | Beginner
description:
A great follow-up to Intro to Golf. This 5-lesson beginner program builds putting, chipping, and full-swing skills, finishing with a coached pitch and putt lesson. Learn basics in rules, etiquette, terminology, and equipment.
Level: Beginner
Number of Classes:5
Class Duration: 60-minute lessons, 90-minute pitch and putt session
Min/Max number of participants: 4
Rental club available
Classes are conducted in rain or shine
Class cancellation / refund policy: 7 days' notice is required for cancellation and refund.

title: After School: Lego Challenge
description: Take your building skills to the next level. Each session, participants will be tasked with creative building challenges using a variety of materials including LEGO®, Keva planks, K'NEX, GraviTrax and more. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program.

title: Babysitter's Training
description: Children learn valuable skills, emergency procedures and tips on childcare. It is recommended that children under 12 not babysit without adult supervision. It is the parent/guardian's responsibility to get children to the program.

description:

title: Adult Golf | The Starter Hut | Beginner
description:
A great follow-up to Intro to Golf. This 5-lesson beginner program builds putting, chipping, and full-swing skills, finishing with a coached pitch and putt lesson. Learn basics in rules, etiquette, terminology, and equipment.
Level: Beginner
Number of Classes:5
Class Duration: 60-minute lessons, 90-minute pitch and putt session
Min/Max number of participants: 4
Rental club available
Classes are conducted in rain or shine
Class cancellation / refund policy: 7 days' notice is required for cancellation and refund.

title: Intro to Gliders
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Gliders skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. If you have basic skating experience please attend an evaluation session. In this level, children receive a facility tour, learn about safety on ice, how to fall down and stand up, and walk on ice without assistance, along with other building blocks to progress to the next level. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

description:
In this fun, upbeat and dynamic class, preschoolers learn the basics of hip hop moves: drops, popping and locking and so much more. A great opportunity for your child to move and groove!
Children participate independently in this program. Please only enter the room if your child requires support. If this is your child's first time participating independently, please inform the instructor on the first day.
Please ensure your child is sent to class with clean, indoor shoes. Absolutely NO rain boots.
Instructor: Piper Brock

description:

- Prorated Fees: Class fees will be adjusted based on the date of enrollment, beginning with the first scheduled class attended.- Private & Semi-Private Options: Select private lessons may be converted into semi-private sessions for two students upon request, please contact the Music and Media Arts Programmer for details.- Make-Up Lessons & Credits: Make-up classes or account credits are only issued in the event of instructor absence or an unexpected facility closure. If you withdraw during this period, you will be charged only for each class you attend without being charged the City of Burnaby refund fee of 10%. title: Reserve In Advance: Squash Court #1
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Reserve In Advance: Squash Court #1
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash and Racquetball.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Flute or Piano: Private Lesson Long-Term Georgia Tuhten
description:
Students can sign up for private flute, beginning piano or theory lessons from fall through spring. Instructor: Georgia Tuhten.
- Prorated Fees: Class fees will be adjusted based on the date of enrollment, beginning with the first scheduled class attended.- Private & Semi-Private Options: Select private lessons may be converted into semi-private sessions for two students upon request, please contact the Music and Media Arts Programmer for details. - Make-Up Lessons & Credits: Make-up classes or account credits are only issued in the event of instructor absence or an unexpected facility closure. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer make-up sessions or credits for student absences.
To give long-term arts students ample time to determine if a long-term program is right for them, students can attend 4 classes before a yearlong commitment is required. If you withdraw during this period, you will be charged only for each class you attend without being charged the City of Burnaby refund fee of 10%. Withdrawals/refunds are not permitted after the start of the 5th class of a long-term program. Payment plan option (via credit card payments) available: 50% of payment due at time of registration, 25% due on Dec 15, and 25% due on Mar 15.

title: Blacksmithing Level 1: Immersion
description:
This extended course is for students who would like a more in-depth introduction to blacksmithing. The hands-on component has students lighting a coal forge, as well as making a coat hook, dinner triangle and striker. Get started on your new blacksmithing hobby with information on what equipment is needed, how and where to get it, and the differences between coal and propane forges. Steel-toed boots recommended.
This Level 1 workshop is considered an introductory blacksmithing course. Successful completion of the course fulfills the prerequisite for taking BVM's Level 2 courses.
Cancellations within 48 hours of the start of the course will not be issued a refund.

title: Intro to Gliders
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Gliders skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. If you have basic skating experience please attend an evaluation session. In this level, children receive a facility tour, learn about safety on ice, how to fall down and stand up, and walk on ice without assistance, along with other building blocks to progress to the next level. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

They’ll learn how to enter and exit the water with help from their parent/caregiver and will play games to encourage them to get their face wet and blow bubbles in the water. Toddlers will also develop floating and kicking skills with the support of their parent/caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.

title: Swimmer 5
description: Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 4. These swimmers will master dives and swimming in deep water. They’ll further their Swim to Survive® skills and start to develop eggbeater kick. Breaststroke, front crawl, and back crawl are further developed. Interval training and sprinting drills continue to challenge these swimmers. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 6
description: Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 5. These swimmers will become proficient at deep water skills including stride entries and compact jumps. They’ll develop lifesaving kicks such as eggbeater and scissor kick. Breaststroke, front crawl, and back crawl are further developed. Head-up swims, interval training and a 300m workout develop strength and endurance. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star.

title: Intro to Gliders
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Gliders skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. If you have basic skating experience please attend an evaluation session. In this level, children receive a facility tour, learn about safety on ice, how to fall down and stand up, and walk on ice without assistance, along with other building blocks to progress to the next level. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

title: Reserve In Advance: Table Tennis All Ages
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Blades 1
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Blades skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. In this level, children learn about safety on the ice, how to fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. By the end of this level children need to be able to skate the width of the rink with confidence using both feet along with demonstrating other building blocks. A CSA approved hockey or snow sports helmet is mandatory for all skate lesson programs. If you require skate rentals, please purchase a skate rental pass on or before the first day of lessons. Please do not register your child for more than one lesson set at a time.

description: Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 4. These swimmers will master dives and swimming in deep water. They’ll further their Swim to Survive® skills and start to develop eggbeater kick. Breaststroke, front crawl, and back crawl are further developed. Interval training and sprinting drills continue to challenge these swimmers. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.

title: Swimmer 6
description: Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 5. These swimmers will become proficient at deep water skills including stride entries and compact jumps. They’ll develop lifesaving kicks such as eggbeater and scissor kick. Breaststroke, front crawl, and back crawl are further developed. Head-up swims, interval training and a 300m workout develop strength and endurance. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description: Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.00.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description: Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Stroke Improvement & Fitness
description: A fun approach to stroke improvement for lifeguard training or an excellent alternative to the weight room. Teens use goal setting, aiming at improving or maintaining their stroke performance, strength and endurance as well as lifesaving support skills. We recommend students be able to swim continuously for a minimum of 250 metres (10 lengths).
ageText: Age at least 12 yrs but less than 16 yrs,

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

description:

REFUND POLICYYou'll receive a full refund if the activity is cancelled or if you request a refund at least 7 days before the start of the activity. If your request comes less than 7 days before the activity starts, there is a 10% refund fee on the original price you paid.

title: Parent & Tot 1 Jellyfish: Adult Participation
description:
Prerequisite: age 4-12 months. Parent & Tot 1 provides an orientation to water for infants and their parent/caregiver. Parents/caregivers will learn how to swim safely with their infant in the pool through instruction of holds and supports. Infants will be introduced to getting their face wet, blowing bubbles and floating with the help of their caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.
Please note: Parent & Tot Level 1 and 2 are taught together as a combined class.
ageText: Age at least 4m but less than 1 yr,

title: Parent & Tot 2 Goldfish: Adult Participation
description:
Prerequisite: age 12-24 months. Parent & Tot 2 teaches toddlers how to play in the water safely! They’ll learn how to enter and exit the water with help from their parent/caregiver and will play games to encourage them to get their face wet and blow bubbles in the water. Toddlers will also develop floating and kicking skills with the support of their parent/caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.
Please note: Parent & Tot Level 1 and 2 are taught together as a combined class.

title: Swimmer 7: Rookie Patrol
description: Rookie Patrol features timed 100-metre swims, 350-metre workouts and swimming while wearing clothes. A work-hard, play-hard approach develops swimming strength and efficiency with emphasis on 'Water Smart' behaviour. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 8: Ranger Patrol
description: Ranger Patrol features timed 200-metre swims, 100-metre fitness medley and the support of a 2.5 kg weight. Skill drills, including a non-contact rescue, enhance swimmers' capabilities in the water. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star.

title: Voice or Piano: Private Lesson Long-Term Kevin Takahide-Lee
description:
Students can sign up for private voice or beginning piano lessons (up to RCM Grade 3 piano) from fall through spring. Instructor: Kevin Takahide-Lee.
- Prorated Fees: Class fees will be adjusted based on the date of enrollment, beginning with the first scheduled class attended.- Private & Semi-Private Options: Select private lessons may be converted into semi-private sessions for two students upon request, please contact the Music and Media Arts Programmer for details. - Make-Up Lessons & Credits: Make-up classes or account credits are only issued in the event of instructor absence or an unexpected facility closure. Unfortunately, we are unable to offer make-up sessions or credits for student absences.
To give long-term arts students ample time to determine if a long-term program is right for them, students can attend 4 classes before a yearlong commitment is required. If you withdraw during this period, you will be charged only for each class you attend without being charged the City of Burnaby refund fee of 10%. Withdrawals/refunds are not permitted after the start of the 5th class of a long-term program. Payment plan option (via credit card payments) available: 50% of payment due at time of registration, 25% due on Dec 15, and 25% due on Mar 15.

description:
Drop-In .Modern dance classes are contemporary based. Using the fundamentals of dance technique students will develop strength, alignment, coordination and expressivity. Wear clothing you can move in and dance in bare feet.
Instructor: Carla Alcantara

title: Swimmer 9: Star Patrol
description:
Star Patrol features times 300-metre swims, 600-metre workouts, lifeguard whistle signals and airway and bleeding first aid priorities. This level demands good physical condition and lifesaving judgement. There is a non-refundable exam fee of $4.25.
Pre-requisite: Completed Swimmer 8 – Ranger Patrol. Star Patrol challenges swimmers with a 300m timed swim, 600m workout and a 25m object carry. Strokes are continued to be refined. Lifesaving skills include use of rescue aids, defense methods, victim removals and supporting a victim in shallow water. First aid focuses on treatment of bone or joint injuries and respiratory emergencies. Once complete, swimmers register into Bronze Star.

description:
This class is designed for runners who have established a consistent running base and are comfortable running continuously for approximately 50-60 minutes. Building on the foundations introduced in the Beginner program, this program includes extended runs, higher-intensity running sessions, and strength-training workouts designed to complement your running and further develop endurance, strength and performance.
*It is recommended that you complete the Running for Beginners program before registering for the Intermediate class.
*Please meet in the lobby at Eileen Dailly. Depending on the workout, the group will either head to the track together or remain at Eileen Dailly for a strength-training session in the fitness class studio. If you are running late for a track session, head directly to Confederation Park Track. Bring a water bottle and wear comfortable athletic shoes and clothing. This program will run rain or shine.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

For more information, contact the Ceramic Arts Programmer: 604-205-3012

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.
