title: Lil' Learners First Exhibition: Adult Participation
description:
Engage young learners in their first art gallery experience through a tour of the Burnaby Art Gallery's current exhibition and then hands on learning at our Barn Studio. Visual literacy skills and art experimentation combine while encouraging play and fine motor skills through monoprinting, painting and collage. Adult participation required (one adult to one child). Cost includes adult fee.
Cancellation with less than 48hrs from the class start date will not receive a refund.
ageText: Age at least 2 yrs but less than 4 yrs,

title: Drop-In Modern Dance: Open level
description:
Drop-In .Modern dance classes are contemporary based. Using the fundamentals of dance technique students will develop strength, alignment, coordination and expressivity. Each class will consist of center technique combinations, floor work, level changing, and movement exploration through improvisation in a supportive environment.
Wear clothing you can move in and dance in bare feet.
Instructor: Carla Alcantara
REFUND POLICYYou'll receive a full refund if the activity is cancelled or if you request a refund at least 7 days before the start of the activity. If your request comes less than 7 days before the activity starts, there is a 10% refund fee on the original price you paid.
After the activity has started, refunds are pro-rated according to the number of sessions remaining and a 10% refund fee will be applied. No refunds will be granted after the third session has ended.
Note: There may be exceptions to these cancellation and refund guidelines as noted in the activity description. Please check your receipt.

title: Reserve In Advance: Combo Court - Squash ONLY
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There is one convertible court (combo court). Bookings in combo court are as per Combo-Squash/Racquetball schedule only.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

In this class we begin with breath and stillness to calm and balance the nervous system, softening the outer body in order to sense the inner body, our fluid centre or core. Then we progress into the structure of Pilates to train and strengthen the core, so that we move more fluidly and with less effort in our lives.

Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This energetic class improves strength, flexibility and balance with a continual flow of postures. Through this practice you cleanse the body, stimulate the cardiovascular system, develop your agility and balance and build muscle tone. Some classes may have extra emphasis on core strength. This class is for able-bodied and experienced students.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Reserve in advance is available for this activity. This is an ideal class for anyone wishing to add more stretching to their workouts. Whether you are a fitness enthusiast, weight trainer, basketball player or swimmer, there is never enough time dedicated to stretching. Supple, flexible bodies help prevent muscle aches, strains and injuries. Stretch muscles from head to toe in this hour long class.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

description: Prerequisite: Completed Preschool 2. Preschool 3 teaches preschoolers how to enter deep water safely wearing a PFD. They’ll learn how to submerge and exhale underwater, retrieve objects underwater, and will continue developing their floating, gliding and kicking skills. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 3 yrs but less than 6 yrs,

title: Swimmer 1: Intro
description: Prerequisite: age 6-14 years. An introduction for beginner swimmers who are not yet comfortable in the water. Swimmers will learn how to open their eyes, exhale, and hold their breath underwater, assisted jumps, floats, glides and kicks. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 1
description: Prerequisite: age 6-14 years. Completed Swimmer 1 Intro or Preschool 3. These beginners will become comfortable jumping into the water with and without a PFD. They’ll learn how to open their eyes, exhale and hold their breath underwater. Floats, glides and kicking skills are introduced. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.
ageText: Age at least 6 yrs but less than 15 yrs,

title: Swimmer 2
description: Prerequisite: Completed Swimmer 1 or Preschool 5. These swimmers will jump into deeper water and learn to be comfortable falling sideways into the water wearing a PFD. They’ll learn how to tread water, develop kicking skills, and will be introduced to front crawl and back crawl. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.00 is applicable.

title: Reserve In Advance: Squash Court #1
description:
Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Jr Golf | FUNdamentals (age 5-7) | Skill Development
description:
Level 2: Building Skills & Confidence — Advancing Your Child’s Golf Game
This 4-week program is designed for young golfers ready to build on the basics and take their skills to the next level. Through engaging practice sessions, kids will refine their putting, chipping, and full swings while learning key aspects of golf rules and etiquette. It’s a great way to boost confidence, improve technique, and deepen their understanding of the game — all in a fun and supportive setting.
Program Details:
  • Duration: 4 sessions (45 minutes each)
  • Equipment: Golf clubs provided if needed, so there’s no need to purchase equipment
  • Weather: Sessions run rain or shine, with access to a covered, heated practice range

Cancellation Policy:
  • Cancellations require a 7-day notice for a full refund

This program is ideal for kids who have some golf experience or have completed the beginner level and are excited to keep progressing. Our friendly coaches help each child develop their skills at their own pace, fostering a positive learning environment that encourages growth and a lifelong love for golf.
Help your child strengthen their skills and passion for golf — sign up today!

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (12-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. Reserve in advance is now available for the sports of Squash.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

prices.description: Child (12-14 yrs) fee for up to 14 years old
Youth (15-25 yrs) fee for 15 up to 25 years old
Adult (26-64 yrs) fee for 26 up to 64 years old
Senior (65+ yrs) fee for 65 or more years old

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

One court booking is 45 minutes. There is a limit of 2 court time slots per day. Maximum 3 players are allowed per court. One participant is required to book the court. The 2 additional players invited to play will need to pay at the time of check-in.

Check-in at the front desk to receive wristband is required before entering the courts.

There are two dedicated Squash courts (court #1 and court #2)

There is a Reserve In Advance Squash Challenge Program on Saturdays and Sundays except statutory holiday weekends. Program capacity is 11 spots. Each participant needs to register their spot. Join a player run recreational game of squash in a round robin style of play.

Drop-ins are subject to remaining spots available. Please arrive early to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in-person drop-in, subject to remaining availability. Participants may lose their spot if they are 10 minutes or more late.

Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.

If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Bronze Cross (for Adults)
description: ADULT PROGRAM. Participants please contact Alvin Cheung or Carson Croy before registering. Prerequisite: Bronze Medallion. Designed for lifesavers who want the challenge of more advanced training, including an introduction to safety supervision in aquatic facilities. Swimmers develop proficiency at performing patient assessments, managing aquatic spinal injuries and preventing loss of life in a variety of aquatic emergencies, while developing stroke endurance and fitness training skills. Includes the CPR-C certification and is one of the prerequisite awards for all advanced Lifeguarding and Leadership training programs. It is also worth two Grade 11 high school credits. Canadian Life Saving Manual is required. There is a non-refundable exam fee. 100% attendance is recommended.

description:
Students can sign up for private lessons in guitar, bass guitar or ukulele from fall through spring. Students must provide their own instrument. Instructor: Craig McCaul.

Unfortunately, we are unable to offer make-up sessions or credits for student absences.
To give long-term arts students ample time to determine if a long-term program is right for them, students can attend 4 classes before a yearlong commitment is required. Withdrawals/refunds are not permitted after the start of the 5th class of a long-term program. Payment plan option (via credit card payments) available: 50% of payment due at time of registration, 25% due on Dec 15, and 25% due on Mar 15.

Toddlers will also develop floating and kicking skills with the support of their parent/caregiver. A non-refundable exam/admin fee of $3.25 is applicable.

title: Blades 1
description: This class is a prerequisite to the Blades skating program for the true beginner: those who have never been on the ice and those who do not know how to skate. In this level, children learn about safety on the ice, how to fall down and stand up, walk on the ice without assistance and are introduced to stopping, gliding and sculling. By the end of this level children need to be able to skate the width of the rink with confidence using both feet along with demonstrating other building blocks. description:

title: Reserve In Advance: Pilates
description:
In this class we begin with breath and stillness to calm and balance the nervous system, softening the outer body in order to sense the inner body, our fluid centre or core. Then we progress into the structure of Pilates to train and strengthen the core, so that we move more fluidly and with less effort in our lives.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Jr Golf | Play (age 8-10) | Skills Development | 8 weeks
description:
A 8-week program designed for developing golfers with some experience. You’ll level up your putting, short game, full swing, and decision-making through fun competitive drills and games, with the goal of playing at the pitch and putt.
Golfers will be provided an environment where they will be supported in development of skills. The achievement of standards leading to confident on course experience.
Level: Beg/int and Intermediate
Number of Classes: 8
Class Duration: 90 mins each
Min/Max number of participants:6
Students are expected to bring their own clubs for this program
Classes are conducted in rain or shine
Class cancellation / refund policy: 7 days' notice is required for cancellation and refund.
ageText: Age at least 8 yrs but less than 12 yrs,

title: Adult Golf: Learn to Play - Putt, Chip, Pitch and Swing
description:
This 2-lesson series introduces the skills and basic understanding needed to start enjoying the game of golf. These lessons focus on building the golf swing and learning to putt and chip with your golf instructor. These lessons teach you golf terminology, equipment needs, rules, etiquette and scorekeeping.
Sessions 1 - 2 are held at Burnaby Mountain Golf Course (90 mins),
All equipment is provided but if you have it, bring your own.
6 per class maximum. 4 minimum.
Classes are conducted rain or shine.
Class cancellation / refund policy: 7 days notice is required for cancellation and refund.

title: Jr Golf | FUNdamentals (age 5-7) | Skills Development
description:
Building Skills & Confidence — Advancing Your Child’s Golf Game
This 4-week program is designed for young golfers ready to build on the basics and take their skills to the next level. Through engaging practice sessions, kids will refine their putting, chipping, and full swings while learning key aspects of golf rules and etiquette. It’s a great way to boost confidence, improve technique, and deepen their understanding of the game — all in a fun and supportive setting.
Program Details:Duration: 4 sessions (45 minutes each)Equipment: Golf clubs provided if needed, so there’s no need to purchase equipmentWeather: Sessions run rain or shine, with access to a covered, heated practice range
Cancellation Policy:Cancellations require a 7-day notice for a full refund
This program is ideal for kids who have some golf experience or have completed the beginner level and are excited to keep progressing. Our friendly coaches help each child develop their skills at their own pace, fostering a positive learning environment that encourages growth and a lifelong love for golf.
Help your child strengthen their skills and passion for golf — sign up today!

Come play this drop-in indoor sport in a positive and enjoyable environment. For all ages, children 6-12 years must be accompanied by a participating adult. Please arrive earl and check in at the front counter to claim your reservation. Participants arriving 10 minutes after activity start time will be considered an in person drop-in, subject to remaining availability.
Customers with a 10 Visit Be Active Pass will be required to pay the drop-in rate at the time of registration for a reserve in advance activity. On the day of your drop-in activity, please visit the front desk to have this charge refunded and a visit taken from your 10 Visit Be Active Pass. Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

Customers with a valid Annual, One Month or Recurring Monthly Be Active Pass will be registered at no charge.
If you are unable to attend, please withdraw from the drop-in activity for the consideration to others. Withdraw online up until the day prior to the activity start date or contact a recreation facility prior to the start of the activity.

title: Cantonese Tour: Jiangang Su, A Thousand Years in One Stream
description:
Join us on Sunday, December 20th for a free guided exhibition tour of Jiangang Su's exhibition, A Thousand Years in One Stream, in Cantonese and Mandarin!
Tours are 30 minutes long.
12:30-1pm – Tour in Cantonese
1-1:30pm – Tour in Mandarin
Ten years ago, Jiangang Su moved to Canada. As he first settled in Burnaby, he was confronted with the quiet depths of this place—taking tranquil walks on the shores of Deer Lake, experiencing a world of timeless waterways co-existing with a city projecting itself into the future. With extensive training in traditional Chinese ink wash and gongbi painting, Su projects his practice towards contemporary calligraphy, where delicate branches and flowing streams emanate breath, movement and the persistence of each moment.
Free to attend, no registration required. For more information, call 604-297-4422 (English only).

title: Swim for Life Instructor Recertification
description: The Swim for Life Instructor Re-cert renews a candidate’s Swim for Life Instructor award for 24 months. Candidates must successfully pass the course and complete a Swim for Life® skills assessment.Candidates must bring their Swim for Life Award Guide and Canadian Swim Patrol Award Guide. *NEW for 2026 - candidates must complete the LSS Online Session: Meeting the Needs of Diverse Swimmers PRIOR to attending the in-person recert. Those not having completed the online session will be turned away.
